steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic directory and file structure for the Android application.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file to specify the application name and package name.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Modify the app/build.gradle file to set the SDK versions, namespace, application ID, and Java compatibility.

steps.title: Set up Android Manifest
steps.description: Define the application's core properties, permissions, and main activity in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Design Main Layout XML
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml to design the user interface, including the display and calculator buttons.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Class
steps.description: Create the MainActivity.java file to handle the application's core logic and UI interactions.

steps.title: Initialize Display TextView
steps.description: Find and set up the TextView in MainActivity to display the calculator input and results.

steps.title: Set Up Number Button Click Listeners
steps.description: Assign OnClickListener events to all number buttons (0-9) and the decimal button, handling input appending.

steps.title: Set Up Operator Button Click Listeners
steps.description: Assign OnClickListener events to all operator buttons (+, -, *, /), storing the first operand and the selected operator.

steps.title: Implement Clear Button Functionality
steps.description: Add an OnClickListener for the 'C' button to reset the calculator state and clear the display.

steps.title: Implement Equals Button Logic
steps.description: Create an OnClickListener for the '=' button to perform the calculation based on the stored operator and current input.

steps.title: Handle Calculation Arithmetic
steps.description: Add logic within the equals button's listener to perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

steps.title: Manage Input State and Display Updates
steps.description: Ensure the display and internal state variables (currentInput, firstOperand, operator) are updated correctly after each button press.

steps.title: Add Division by Zero Error Handling
steps.description: Implement a check to prevent division by zero and display an 'Error' message if it occurs.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Verify that all Java code adheres to Java 8 syntax, using anonymous inner classes for listeners.

steps.title: Final Code Review and Refinements
steps.description: Review all generated files for correctness, consistency, and adherence to Android build rules and best practices.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: The final step to compile and assemble the Android application package (APK).
